description: Implementation of the TaskPool class managing tasks and events in the prplMesh agent, including task addition, execution, event handling, and message processing.

classes.name: TaskPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of tasks, handles event distribution, and executes tasks within time constraints.

methods.name: add_task_no_events
methods.description: Adds a task to the pool without handling events.

methods.name: add_task
methods.description: Adds a task to the pool and registers its events.

methods.name: run_tasks
methods.description: Executes tasks and processes event queue within a specified maximum duration.

methods.name: try_send_event
methods.description: Attempts to send an event to a specific task type.

methods.name: send_event
methods.description: Sends an event to a specific task type or to the event queue.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes a received CMDU message across tasks.
